episode_reviews.notes: Reviewed all 70 saved video frames and the complete trace. The robot deliberately turns the stove knob on, then approaches and closes on the actual middle-drawer handle, pulling that drawer outward. It spends an extended interval near the stove before moving to the cabinet, but the requested drawer action is eventually performed. Stove-on remains true at every saved control after its first native milestone. Both requested native goals begin false; no pre-opened middle drawer or accidental cabinet-body motion establishes success. The middle drawer remains robot-held during the terminal pull, which is consistent with the requested open action; no object placement is claimed.
